description: Header file defining the aom_image_t structure and related functions for image manipulation in the AOMedia library, including image formats, color primaries, transfer characteristics, and image operations.

methods.name: aom_img_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes an image descriptor with specified format, dimensions, and alignment.

methods.name: aom_img_wrap
methods.description: Wraps existing storage into an image descriptor with specified format and dimensions.

methods.name: aom_img_alloc_with_border
methods.description: Allocates an image descriptor with borders and specified format, dimensions, and alignment.

methods.name: aom_img_set_rect
methods.description: Sets the displayed rectangle (viewport) of the image.

methods.name: aom_img_free
methods.description: Frees all storage associated with an image descriptor.

methods.name: aom_img_plane_width
methods.description: Returns the width of a specified plane in the image.

methods.name: aom_img_plane_height
methods.description: Returns the height of a specified plane in the image.
